description: Ceph cluster health, I/O latency, BlueStore performance, and per-OSD breakdowns via the standalone ceph-exporter (:9926) on trinity/neo/smith.

panels.description: OSDs currently reporting metrics (one exporter per Proxmox host exposes its local OSDs).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS value FROM (SELECT Attributes['ceph_daemon'] AS ceph_daemon FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='ceph_osd_numpg' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY ceph_daemon)

panels.title: OSDs Up

panels.description: Sum of client read + write ops/s across all OSDs.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(delta)/300 AS value FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d)) AS delta FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='ceph_osd_op' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN now() - INTERVAL 900 SECOND AND now() WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY MetricName, ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 300 SECOND

panels.title: Client IOPS

panels.description: Aggregate read + write throughput across OSDs.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(delta)/300 AS value FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d)) AS delta FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName IN ('ceph_osd_op_in_bytes','ceph_osd_op_out_bytes') AND TimeUnix BETWEEN now() - INTERVAL 900 SECOND AND now() WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY MetricName, ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 300 SECOND

panels.title: Client Throughput

panels.description: Ops currently being processed on primaries. Growing values indicate the cluster is falling behind client load.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(v),0) AS value FROM (SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='ceph_osd_op_wip' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'])

panels.title: Ops In Flight

panels.description: Recovery ops/s across all OSDs. Non-zero means the cluster is rebalancing or repairing replicas.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(delta)/300 AS value FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d)) AS delta FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='ceph_osd_recovery_ops' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN now() - INTERVAL 900 SECOND AND now() WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY MetricName, ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 300 SECOND

panels.title: Recovery Ops/s

panels.description: Total monitor sessions open across all MONs. Drops correlate with client disconnects.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(v),0) AS value FROM (SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='ceph_mon_num_sessions' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'])

panels.title: MON Sessions

panels.description: MON elections within the last hour. Repeated elections indicate network flaps or MON instability.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(delta),0) AS value FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d)) AS delta FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='ceph_mon_election_call' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN now() - INTERVAL 4200 SECOND AND now() WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY MetricName, ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 3600 SECOND

panels.title: Elections (1h)

panels.description: RGW requests/s across all gateways.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(delta)/300 AS value FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d)) AS delta FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='ceph_rgw_req' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN now() - INTERVAL 900 SECOND AND now() WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY MetricName, ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 300 SECOND

panels.title: RGW Requests
Client I/O Latency — the money chart for slow-OSD diagnosis

panels.description: Average client write commit latency per OSD. This is the critical signal: Ceph blocks client writes on the slowest replica in the acting set, so a single slow OSD drags everyone.

targets.rawSql: SELECT n.time AS time, n.ceph_daemon AS ceph_daemon, n.delta/greatest(d.delta,n.step) AS value FROM (SELECT time, ceph_daemon, sum(delta) AS delta, any(step) AS step FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS step, Attributes['ceph_daemon'] AS ceph_daemon, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d)) AS delta FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='ceph_osd_op_w_latency_sum' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['ceph_daemon'] IN (${osd:singlequote}), $osd) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY MetricName, ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, ceph_daemon) n INNER JOIN (SELECT time, ceph_daemon, sum(delta) AS delta, any(step) AS step FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS step, Attributes['ceph_daemon'] AS ceph_daemon, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d)) AS delta FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='ceph_osd_op_w_latency_count' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['ceph_daemon'] IN (${osd:singlequote}), $osd) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY MetricName, ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, ceph_daemon) d ON n.time=d.time AND n.ceph_daemon=d.ceph_daemon ORDER BY time

panels.title: Write Commit Latency (avg per OSD)

panels.description: Average client read latency per OSD.

targets.rawSql: SELECT n.time AS time, n.ceph_daemon AS ceph_daemon, n.delta/greatest(d.delta,n.step) AS value FROM (SELECT time, ceph_daemon, sum(delta) AS delta, any(step) AS step FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS step, Attributes['ceph_daemon'] AS ceph_daemon, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d)) AS delta FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='ceph_osd_op_r_latency_sum' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['ceph_daemon'] IN (${osd:singlequote}), $osd) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY MetricName, ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, ceph_daemon) n INNER JOIN (SELECT time, ceph_daemon, sum(delta) AS delta, any(step) AS step FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS step, Attributes['ceph_daemon'] AS ceph_daemon, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d)) AS delta FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='ceph_osd_op_r_latency_count' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['ceph_daemon'] IN (${osd:singlequote}), $osd) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY MetricName, ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, ceph_daemon) d ON n.time=d.time AND n.ceph_daemon=d.ceph_daemon ORDER BY time

panels.title: Read Latency (avg per OSD)
BlueStore / BlueFS — where client latency actually comes from

panels.description: RocksDB KV commit latency. Spikes here propagate directly to client write latency.

targets.rawSql: SELECT n.time AS time, n.ceph_daemon AS ceph_daemon, n.delta/greatest(d.delta,n.step) AS value FROM (SELECT time, ceph_daemon, sum(delta) AS delta, any(step) AS step FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS step, Attributes['ceph_daemon'] AS ceph_daemon, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d)) AS delta FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='ceph_bluestore_kv_commit_lat_sum' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['ceph_daemon'] IN (${osd:singlequote}), $osd) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY MetricName, ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, ceph_daemon) n INNER JOIN (SELECT time, ceph_daemon, sum(delta) AS delta, any(step) AS step FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS step, Attributes['ceph_daemon'] AS ceph_daemon, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d)) AS delta FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='ceph_bluestore_kv_commit_lat_count' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['ceph_daemon'] IN (${osd:singlequote}), $osd) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY MetricName, ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, ceph_daemon) d ON n.time=d.time AND n.ceph_daemon=d.ceph_daemon ORDER BY time

panels.title: KV Commit Latency

panels.description: Time waiting on the kernel AIO queue to accept writes. Direct signal for NVMe slowness.

targets.rawSql: SELECT n.time AS time, n.ceph_daemon AS ceph_daemon, n.delta/greatest(d.delta,n.step) AS value FROM (SELECT time, ceph_daemon, sum(delta) AS delta, any(step) AS step FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS step, Attributes['ceph_daemon'] AS ceph_daemon, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d)) AS delta FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='ceph_bluestore_state_aio_wait_lat_sum' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['ceph_daemon'] IN (${osd:singlequote}), $osd) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY MetricName, ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, ceph_daemon) n INNER JOIN (SELECT time, ceph_daemon, sum(delta) AS delta, any(step) AS step FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS step, Attributes['ceph_daemon'] AS ceph_daemon, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d)) AS delta FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='ceph_bluestore_state_aio_wait_lat_count' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['ceph_daemon'] IN (${osd:singlequote}), $osd) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY MetricName, ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, ceph_daemon) d ON n.time=d.time AND n.ceph_daemon=d.ceph_daemon ORDER BY time

panels.title: BlueStore AIO Wait Latency

panels.description: BlueFS fsync latency. High values correlate with DB_DEVICE_STALLED_READ alerts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT n.time AS time, n.ceph_daemon AS ceph_daemon, n.delta/greatest(d.delta,n.step) AS value FROM (SELECT time, ceph_daemon, sum(delta) AS delta, any(step) AS step FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS step, Attributes['ceph_daemon'] AS ceph_daemon, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d)) AS delta FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='ceph_bluefs_fsync_lat_sum' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['ceph_daemon'] IN (${osd:singlequote}), $osd) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY MetricName, ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, ceph_daemon) n INNER JOIN (SELECT time, ceph_daemon, sum(delta) AS delta, any(step) AS step FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS step, Attributes['ceph_daemon'] AS ceph_daemon, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d)) AS delta FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='ceph_bluefs_fsync_lat_count' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['ceph_daemon'] IN (${osd:singlequote}), $osd) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY MetricName, ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, ceph_daemon) d ON n.time=d.time AND n.ceph_daemon=d.ceph_daemon ORDER BY time

panels.title: BlueFS fsync Latency

panels.description: Client read ops/s per OSD. Imbalance can indicate primary-affinity or CRUSH weight issues.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, ceph_daemon, sum(delta)/any(step) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS step, Attributes['ceph_daemon'] AS ceph_daemon, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d)) AS delta FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='ceph_osd_op_r' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['ceph_daemon'] IN (${osd:singlequote}), $osd) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY MetricName, ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, ceph_daemon ORDER BY time

panels.title: Read IOPS per OSD

panels.description: Client write ops/s per OSD.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, ceph_daemon, sum(delta)/any(step) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS step, Attributes['ceph_daemon'] AS ceph_daemon, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d)) AS delta FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='ceph_osd_op_w' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['ceph_daemon'] IN (${osd:singlequote}), $osd) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY MetricName, ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, ceph_daemon ORDER BY time

panels.title: Write IOPS per OSD

panels.description: Read (positive) and write (negative) throughput per OSD.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, ceph_daemon, sum(delta)/any(step) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS step, concat(Attributes['ceph_daemon'],' read') AS ceph_daemon, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d)) AS delta FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='ceph_osd_op_r_out_bytes' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['ceph_daemon'] IN (${osd:singlequote}), $osd) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY MetricName, ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, ceph_daemon ORDER BY time

SELECT time, concat(ceph_daemon, ' write') AS ceph_daemon, -sum(delta)/any(step) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS step, Attributes['ceph_daemon'] AS ceph_daemon, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d)) AS delta FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='ceph_osd_op_w_in_bytes' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['ceph_daemon'] IN (${osd:singlequote}), $osd) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY MetricName, ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, ceph_daemon ORDER BY time

panels.title: Throughput per OSD

panels.description: Ops currently being processed (primary replica). High/sticky values indicate backpressure from a slow OSD.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['ceph_daemon'] AS ceph_daemon, avg(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='ceph_osd_op_wip' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['ceph_daemon'] IN (${osd:singlequote}), $osd) GROUP BY time, ceph_daemon ORDER BY time

panels.title: Ops In Flight per OSD

panels.description: PG count per OSD. Uneven distribution after primary-affinity or weight changes is normal; large imbalance suggests CRUSH/reweight action.

targets.rawSql: SELECT Attributes['ceph_daemon'] AS ceph_daemon, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='ceph_osd_numpg' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['ceph_daemon'] IN (${osd:singlequote}), $osd) GROUP BY ceph_daemon

panels.title: PGs per OSD

panels.description: Recovery ops/s per OSD. Non-zero means the cluster is backfilling or repairing.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, ceph_daemon, sum(delta)/any(step) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS step, Attributes['ceph_daemon'] AS ceph_daemon, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d)) AS delta FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='ceph_osd_recovery_ops' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['ceph_daemon'] IN (${osd:singlequote}), $osd) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY MetricName, ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, ceph_daemon ORDER BY time

panels.title: Recovery Ops/s per OSD

panels.description: Open client sessions per MON. A drop on one MON usually means clients re-elected to another.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['ceph_daemon'] AS ceph_daemon, avg(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='ceph_mon_num_sessions' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, ceph_daemon ORDER BY time

panels.title: MON Sessions

panels.description: Messenger connections closed due to idle/ready timeouts. Sustained rate indicates network-layer issues between daemons.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, ceph_daemon, sum(delta)/any(step) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS step, Attributes['ceph_daemon'] AS ceph_daemon, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d)) AS delta FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName IN ('ceph_AsyncMessenger_Worker_msgr_connection_idle_timeouts','ceph_AsyncMessenger_Worker_msgr_connection_ready_timeouts') AND Attributes['ceph_daemon'] != '' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY MetricName, ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, ceph_daemon ORDER BY time

panels.title: Messenger Connection Timeouts

panels.description: DB (RocksDB) device usage per OSD. Runaway DB usage precedes compaction storms and can stall reads.

targets.rawSql: SELECT u.ceph_daemon AS ceph_daemon, u.v/nullIf(t.v,0) AS value FROM (SELECT Attributes['ceph_daemon'] AS ceph_daemon, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='ceph_bluefs_db_used_bytes' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['ceph_daemon'] IN (${osd:singlequote}), $osd) GROUP BY ceph_daemon) u INNER JOIN (SELECT Attributes['ceph_daemon'] AS ceph_daemon, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='ceph_bluefs_db_total_bytes' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['ceph_daemon'] IN (${osd:singlequote}), $osd) GROUP BY ceph_daemon) t ON u.ceph_daemon=t.ceph_daemon

panels.title: BlueFS DB Usage per OSD

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT Attributes['ceph_daemon'] FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='ceph_osd_numpg' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
list.label: OSD
list.name: osd
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT Attributes['ceph_daemon'] FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='ceph_osd_numpg' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR

title: Ceph
